question: Did HN stories shift from chatbots to agents?
why: It shows when AI talk on HN moved from one product name to a way of building.
opening: From {window_b}, {n_b} stories matched "agent" or "agents" and {m_b} matched "ChatGPT" or "GPT". From {window_a}, it was {n_a} and {m_a}.
takeaway: Agent stories went from {b} to {a} per chatbot story, a {ratio}x change. The card's rule for yes was {support_at}x or more.
boundary: "Agent" also matches secret agent and user agent. The base is every story since 2006, so it is dominated by the most recent early years and the direction matters more than the size. Matches show wording in stories, not what developers use.
